Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for GAIL Medical Consultant - Part-Time Visiting Consultant MD (Medicine) Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for GAIL Medical Consultant post?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the GAIL Medical Consultant post is scheduled for 30th September 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue on time with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q2. What is the eligibility criteria for the Medical Consultant position at GAIL?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS & MD (Medicine) from a recognized University/Institution and have a valid registration with the National Medical Commission (NMC) or the concerned State Medical Council. Post-qualification experience is desirable.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Part-Time Visiting Medical Consultant role?
faq.answer: The salary for the Medical Consultant (Specialist PG Degree in MD (Medicine)) is ₹3,500/- per hour. Additionally, conveyance charges of Rs. 14/- per km will be provided.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the GAIL Medical Consultant position?
faq.answer: The application process is through a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to download the application form from GAIL's website, fill it, and submit it along with required documents at the interview venue on the specified date.

faq.question: Q5. What documents do I need to carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies of testimonials, an updated Resume/CV, and two recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at GAIL Bhopal Zonal Office, 2nd Floor, 8, Maple High Street, Hoshangabad Road, in front of Aashima Mall, Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh - 462026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: The job is on a temporary tenure basis, and the position is for a Part-Time Visiting Medical Consultant.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves an interview before the Selection Committee.

faq.question: Q10. Can I download the application form from the website?
faq.answer: Yes, you can download the prescribed Application Form from the "Careers" section of GAIL's official website, www.gailonline.com.
